summary: Sigma Lithium filed a Form 6-K on July 9, 2026, attaching a press release reporting Q2 2026 production results. The company produced 35,000 tonnes of lithium concentrate, exceeding guidance of 33,000 tonnes, and provided production cost estimates and cash flow forecasts under various lithium price scenarios. The filing is an operational update with no transaction, shareholder vote, or strategic change. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign. No deal terms are present. This is a routine earnings-style current report on a foreign private issuer's operations.
